From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@avasaas.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Modularizing our Redwood package — feature swap + seat credits?

Hi Camila,

Quick note from our side as we look at H2 planning. We're interested in breaking apart the current bundle (Core + Insights + Priority Support) into more modular SKUs so product teams can pick features per team. Two asks:

- Can you provide per-feature SKU pricing (monthly) and an example of a modular bundle discount ladder?
- If we move from a committed 200-seat pool to a 150-seat pool mid-contract, how do you handle credits for the unused committed seats? Any precedent/limits?

Attached is a short needs assessment that lists which teams want which features. Our procurement lead (procurement@avasaas.com) will need an amendment/PO-ready doc if we proceed. We're aiming to finalize commercial terms by mid-July.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Platform
AvA SaaS

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@avasaas.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Modularizing our Redwood package — feature swap + seat credits?

Hi Jordan — great context, thanks for sharing the assessment. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can land a clean amendment: 

- Is the goal to have a single consolidated contract with modular add-ons, or to move some teams onto a separate contract for the modular plan?
- Do you expect the 150-seat target to be the long-term committed quantity, or a temporary adjustment ahead of H2 hires?

High-level options we typically use:
- Tier-swap (same contract): move seats between tiers, prorated credit for unused committed seats (standard approach: prorated by remaining term; see example below).
- Modular add-on SKUs: keep base commitment, purchase feature add-ons month-to-month; smaller commitment options with lower discount.
- One-time buy-down credit: for mid-term downsize we can offer an upfront credit applied to future spend (requires exec approval).

I'll loop in Ben for a pricing sketch and will draft an amendment we can send to procurement. Expect a pricing PDF + amendment draft tomorrow.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing sketch: AvA modular proposal (internal)

Team — quick sketch based on Jordan's ask and historical playbook. Notes below are internal and subject to final legal review.

Proposed approach (preferred):
- Keep single contract, introduce modular add-on SKUs for Insights and Priority Support.
- Base commitment: 150 committed seats (annual). Existing committed seats (200) buy-down treated as: prorated credit = (unused seats) * (monthly seat rate) * (months remaining). Cap credit at 3 months of committed spend for fairness.
- Example: unused = 50 seats, monthly rate = $18/seat, months remaining = 6 -> credit = 50*18*6 = $5,400 (we can offer up to $12,000 as a one-time goodwill credit if leadership approves).

Discounts:
- Modular bundle discount: 10% for modular mix >= $30k ARR, 15% for >= $75k ARR.
- One-time incentive: 1-month free on the first add-on if they commit to an annual add-on purchase.

Open items for legal/procurement:
- Amendment language for seat buy-down and effective date.
- SSO/SSP, data residency clauses (Jordan mentioned SAML).

Attaching the modular pricing PDF for client-facing. I'll mark the one-time credit option as exec-only.

Thanks,
Ben
[Attachment: Redwood_Modular_Pricing_v2.pdf]

- Prorated credit for 50 unused seats calculated as monthly seat-rate * months remaining; we have a one-time goodwill credit option of up to $12,000 (exec approval required) which could be applied to your first add-on purchases.
- Modular add-ons: Insights (per-seat), Priority Support (flat per-account). Details in the pricing PDF.

Hi — quick answers: 

1) Credit formula (in amendment): prorated_credit = unused_committed_seats * monthly_seat_rate * full_months_remaining_on_term. Example provided in the amendment; legal can substitute exact seat-rate value. We include the optional one-time goodwill credit as a separate line item (not to exceed $12,000) and only applied if sign-off from Redwood VP of Sales.

2) Yes — Redwood supports IdP-initiated SAML. Enabling it does not change the amendment effective date; it's a deployment configuration. Our SRE will partner on SOC/SSO setup within 2 weeks of amendment effective date.

3) Signatory: Markus Klein, VP Sales, Redwood Inference (markus_klein@redwood.ai).

I've uploaded the marked amendment and the pricing PDF to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/rdw/rdw-4521/proposal. DocuSign will include a field for PO number — please add PO when you sign.

Ben will set up the pricing wrap call — I believe he suggested July 6. If that doesn't work for your calendar, let us know alternative windows around the Jul 12 sign-off target.

Thanks,
Camila
